import pandas as pd
from datetime import date

AS_OF = date(2026,7,28)
# June 2026: 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-30
orders = pd.read_csv('don_hang.csv')
details = pd.read_csv('chi_tiet_don.csv')

# valid orders: not cancelled, not returned -> completed + shipping
valid_status = ['completed','shipping']

june = orders[(orders['Ngày']>='2026-06-01') & (orders['Ngày']<='2026-06-30')]
valid = june[june['Tình trạng'].isin(valid_status)]

print("total june orders:", len(june))
print("valid orders (completed+shipping):", len(valid))
print("cancelled:", (june['Tình trạng']=='cancelled').sum(), "returned:", (june['Tình trạng']=='returned').sum())

# revenue = sum of Amount per valid order
rev = valid['Mã chứng từ'].map(details['Amount']).fillna(0).groupby(valid['Mã chứng từ']).sum()
total_rev = rev.sum()
n = len(valid)
avg = total_rev / n
print("total revenue:", total_rev)
print("count:", n)
print("avg revenue per order:", avg)
